title: Row actions are bare glyphs (▶ ✓ ◎) whose meaning is only in hover titles. ✓ (mark goal done) sits where an approve button would be expected.
repro: Open Home and look at a row's buttons.
expected: Labelled or self-evident actions; ✓ not confusable with approve.
actual: ▶ = replay, ✓ = mark goal done, ◎ = set goal, each explained only by a tooltip.

why: kestrel's stuck row shows 'Approve ▶ ✓ ◎'. ▶ 'Replay this session', ✓ 'Mark goal done' and ◎ 'Set goal' are glyph-only, with their meaning only in title tooltips. ✓ sits right next to Approve on a blocked row, where a quick click marks the goal done instead of approving (shots 02, 07).

title: ◎ prefills `/goal …` but Enter does nothing until a key is typed (the Send button stays disabled, blocking implicit submit)
repro: Run any command (Send becomes disabled)
Click ◎ on a row → the bar shows `/goal <current goal>` with the caret
Press ⏎
actual: 3/3: no submit event, no note, text unchanged, Send arrow grey. After one keystroke (space + backspace) ⏎ submitted "Goal for Run build.sh: …".

why: 3/3: after a command (Send disabled), ◎ on vibepet prefilled "/goal " with the caret in the bar. Enter then did nothing: input unchanged, 0 notes, 0 set-goal IPC. Control: Space, Backspace, then Enter submitted. The prefill sets .value without an input event, so Send stays disabled, and a disabled default button blocks implicit submission.
cause: renderer/app.js:933 (prefill never enables #chatSend); renderer/app.js:868 + renderer/app.js:872 (Send disabled after a command, re-enabled only by input events)

title: [M2] AskUserQuestion cannot be answered from the pet: no question, no options, no Reply; the row reads running and vanishes at 120 s
repro: beacon idle; send its arm prompt (AskUserQuestion: which database)
Open Home
Watch beacon's row for 130 s
expected: A 'needs you' row with the question and its options (SQLite / Postgres / Redis / Type something), answerable in ≤2 clicks.
actual: Row 'beacon · 0s' read RUNNING with ▶ ✓ ◎ only; no question text, options or Reply at any point; removed at +120.0 s while the registry still said waiting(input needed). The only blocked-row action in the code is Approve = Enter on the highlighted option; its send-to probe for beacon returned "couldn't find its tab" (87 ms).
truth: registry waiting(input needed) since 01:54:41.4Z; pane: 'Which database should beacon use to store check results? 1. SQLite 2. Postgres 3. Redis 4. Type something. 5. Chat about this'; transcript last record = user prompt

title: After ✓ the row's buttons shift right and ▶ slides under the cursor: a quick second click opens Theater
repro: Row with a goal (✓ offered)
Click ✓
Click again on the same spot 250–400 ms later (double-click or 'did it take?')
expected: Buttons keep their positions (or the second click is harmless).
actual: Before: ▶@530 ✓@562 ◎@594; after ✓: ▶@562 ◎@594. The second click opened Theater 2 of 3 (250 ms and 400 ms gaps; not at 600 ms).

title: ✓ (goal done) has no undo and counts again after a reset: Today reports more hits than goals and xp is farmable
repro: Press ✓ on a row's goal
◎ → '/goal ' → Enter (the only way back: reset to the first prompt)
Press ✓ again; repeat
expected: A mistaken ✓ can be undone in place; a goal is counted as hit once.
actual: No undo on the row. Resetting brings ✓ back and each press adds a goal_done (+15 xp): Today read 'Goals set: 12 · hit: 13'; the same first-prompt goal was counted 3x; xp went 0 → 195 with a 'LEVEL 3!' bubble.

title: Icon-only ✓ and ◎ sit next to Reply/Approve: ✓ reads as approve/accept but means 'mark goal done'; ◎ means 'set goal'; meanings only in tooltips
repro: Look at a blocked or needs row's buttons
expected: Actions are labelled in words (or unambiguous icons) so a glance tells approve from 'goal done'.
actual: Rows show 'Reply ▶ ✓ ◎' / '▶ ✓ ◎'; ✓ marks the goal done (+15 xp), it does not approve, accept or dismiss the session.

title: No Deny / 'No' for a permission prompt from the pet
repro: kestrel shows its permission dialog (1 Yes / 2 Yes, don't ask again / 3 No / Esc)
Look for a way to refuse from the pet
expected: Approve and Deny side by side on the blocked row.
actual: No deny/reject action on any row state (blocked rows offer at most Approve; here not even that). Refusing needs the terminal, which jump can't open on tmux.
truth: registry waiting(permission prompt); dialog offers '3. No' and Esc

title: No Stop / Interrupt (Esc) for a running or looping session
repro: A session runs a long tool (atlas build.sh) or a fan-out (delta)
Look for a way to stop it from the pet
expected: A Stop/Interrupt action on running rows (and on /loop sessions).
actual: Running rows offer only ▶ ✓ ◎; no interrupt anywhere in the row, roster or command bar.
truth: atlas busy running build.sh; delta busy with 3 subagents

title: No way to give a finished session its next instruction: Reply exists only when the turn ends with '?'
repro: A session finishes its turn with a statement (vibepet: 'The app's main entry file is main.js.')
Look for a way to send the next prompt from its row
expected: A Reply/'next' box on finished (ready) rows — the most frequent action with 5–15 sessions.
actual: Ready rows offer ▶ ✓ ◎ only; the row click (jump) fails on tmux, so the next instruction always means leaving the pet and finding the terminal by hand.
truth: vibepet idle at its prompt after end_turn 02:12:19Z

expected: The pet offers the same choice the dialog does.
actual: Only a single Approve exists (and only for stalled rows); no allow-always option.
truth: dialog option 2 present in the pane

title: No 'open diff / changed files' action on a row
repro: A session finished a turn
Look for what it changed
expected: One click from the row to the diff or the list of changed files.
actual: No such action on rows, roster or command bar; the only window a row opens is Theater (whole-session replay).

title: No batch actions across sessions (approve several, dismiss finished rows)
repro: Several sessions need attention at once
expected: Batch approve / acknowledge where it makes sense.
actual: Every action is per row; finished rows can't be dismissed (they disappear on their own after ~5 min).

title: No keyboard shortcuts for row actions
repro: Home open, chat input focused
Try to approve/reply/jump the top row from the keyboard
expected: Keys for the top needs-you row (e.g. reply, approve, jump), usable without the mouse.
actual: Only Esc is handled; reaching a row button takes ~8 Shift+Tabs and the focus is then lost at the next redraw.

title: ◎ on a guessed (auto) goal opens an empty '/goal ': the guess can't be edited, only retyped
repro: Row whose goal is the session's first prompt (auto)
Click ◎
expected: The chat input is prefilled with the current goal text, as it is for a typed goal.
actual: Prefill was '/goal ' (empty) for the auto goal; for a typed goal it was '/goal <text>'.
truth: kestrel's auto goal = its first prompt

why: beacon held its AskUserQuestion (registry waiting(input needed) since 02:13:42Z, pane 'Enter to select', transcript last record = the prompt) through my whole 16-min session and never got a row: no question, no options, no Reply (shots A01–C06). Same withheld-record path as r1-S4-01 (running for ≤120 s after the last write, then parked; observed on kestrel). Separately, when the tool_use IS written, vibepet's ask for each of the 14 AskUserQuestion records in beacon's transcript evaluates to just 'AskUserQuestion' (toolAsk reads command/file_path/pattern/url/description, never questions/options), and the only action on a stalled row is Approve = Enter on the highlighted option. Approve's send-to probe on beacon: {ok:false, couldn't find its tab} (92–104 ms). Not a duplicate of r1-S4-01: the question/options gap remains after detection is fixed.

Before ✓: ▶@544 ✓@576 ◎@608; after ✓: ▶@576 ◎@608. A second click on ✓'s old spot 300 ms and 400 ms later opened Theater 2/2 (ipc:theater recorded, a second window). ✓ is removed once the goal is done, and the buttons sit in a right-aligned auto grid column, so ▶ slides into ✓'s slot.

After ✓ the button disappears and there is no undo. '/goal ' (reset) brings back the same auto goal, not done. 3 reset+✓ cycles wrote 3 goal_done rows for 'Run exactly ./deploy.sh --dry-run…'. Today read 'Goals set: 2 · hit: 5' and xp went 0→75 (+15 each). Auto goals write no goal_set, and today() counts every goal_done row.

The stuck row renders 'Approve ▶ ✓ ◎' (C06) and the needs row 'Reply ▶ ✓ ◎' (B01). ✓ and ◎ have no text and no aria-label; their meaning is only in title tooltips ('Mark goal done', 'Set goal'). ✓ next to Approve reads as accept, and a mis-press can't be undone (r1-S4-10).
kestrel's real permission dialog offers '3. No' and Esc, but its stuck row offered only Approve, ▶, (✓) and ◎ (C03, C06). No row state, roster or command offers deny, No or Esc.
Running rows (atlas busy in build.sh; A02, C06) offer only ▶ ✓ ◎. There is no interrupt or Esc anywhere; the command bar's /stop stops localhost ports, not sessions.
Ready rows (vibepet 'done 1m ago' in A02; ember 'done 2m ago' in C06) offer ▶ ✓ ◎ or ▶ ◎ only. Reply exists only for phase 'waiting', and classify assigns that only when the last text ends with '?'.
kestrel's dialog offers '2. Yes, and don't ask again for: ./deploy.sh *'. Its stuck row offers a single Approve (Enter on the highlighted option) and nothing else (C03, C06).

No row has a diff or changed-files action (A02, B01, C06). The per-turn receipt (files touched, +/−, check verdict) is computed in agents.js receipt() and sent in the snapshot, but its renderer rcLine() has no callers, so it never appears.

Every action is per row. At 02:59, with 4 rows listed (kestrel stuck, delta and ember ready, atlas running), there was no multi-select and no dismiss. Finished rows can't be acknowledged; they vanish 5 min after the turn (vibepet's ready row disappeared at 02:45:56.7, 5 min after its 02:40:56 end_turn).

The renderer handles only Escape. Reaching a row button took 8 Shift+Tabs from the chat bar, and that focus fell to BODY at the next redraw (2973 ms). The global jump key is the S7 surface, is off in tests, and jump fails on tmux anyway.

◎ on kestrel's auto goal ('Run exactly ./deploy.sh --dry-run with the Bash tool.') filled the bar with '/goal ' (empty). After a typed goal, ◎ filled '/goal Critic goal one'. The prefill drops auto goals by design of that expression.
